project_type: Next.js 16 web app in a Yarn 4 monorepo (apps/web workspace)
build_system: Yarn 4 workspaces with corepack. Commands target web workspace.
test_framework: Vitest with vi mocking, tests colocated as *.test.ts next to source files
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'yarn workspace web typecheck' - must pass with no errors. 2. Run 'yarn workspace web test' - all new/modified tests must pass. Pre-existing failures in billing/plans.test.ts and one drawtext test are known.
setup_instructions: Already set up. 'yarn workspaces focus web' installs deps. Node 22 with corepack.
environment_constraints: No Docker daemon available. FFmpeg is installed for smoke tests. Network allows npm packages. Pre-existing test failures: billing/plans.test.ts (2 failures), ffmpeg-compose.test.ts drawtext overlay test (1 failure - text overlays disabled in code).
contribution_requirements: Code follows existing patterns. Tests colocated. Path alias @/ maps to apps/web/src/.
key_patterns: UGC pipeline: orchestrate.ts chains steps (scrape->script->TTS->assets->scenePlan->compose). Each module exports pure functions + async orchestration functions. Tests mock external deps (fetch, puppeteer, storage). chatCompletionJson for structured GPT calls. presignUpload/presignDownload for R2 storage. FFmpeg args built as string[] via buildUGCFfmpegArgs.
directory_structure: apps/web/src/lib/ugc/ - UGC pipeline (orchestrate, compose, ffmpeg-compose, types, captions). apps/web/src/lib/tts/ - TTS generation (generate, script-to-audio, types). apps/web/src/lib/assets/ - Asset management (image-gen, scene-planner, product-images, types). apps/web/src/lib/render/ - General render pipeline types. apps/web/src/app/api/ - API routes and utilities (ai, sql, storage).
